name: Receiving Workflow
summary: Primary guided, manual, and edit receiving flow with settings-driven startup, validation gates, module-scoped unsaved state, weak-event workflow notifications, final save orchestration, Manual Mode part-first or PO-first part/PO resolution, textbox-based Manual Mode location entry, package-type updates for Manual Mode rows, a mode-selection action that reconciles saved MTM loads against InforVisual receipt history, current inventory totals, and transaction-history smart-fix evidence, a resized reconciliation review modal that presents proposed changes more cleanly before any row is updated, user-scoped reconciliation preferences that can ignore configured locations during automatic review, a JSON-backed mock Infor Visual catalog plus runtime transaction store for default PO and location behavior, mock-mode save writes that preserve whole-load quantities while aggregating mocked destination totals by location, PO-assisted part ordering that prioritizes earlier expected receive dates before mostly satisfied lines, and PO due-date persistence that prefers the selected line-level date before falling back to the PO header promise date.
